nutrition.reserveInterpretation: Population aggregate changes include births/deaths; not a paired surviving-body reserve trend.

soil.units: Approximate soil nutrient units: modeled growth consumes .004 units per gram and detritus mineralization returns .004 units per decayed gram. Not elemental mass or a closed nutrient cycle.
soil.nutrientTransferDefinition: No direct soil-to-soil actuator or transfer runs in these trials. Local material deposits return nutrients only through measured mineralization; consumption is plant uptake.
soil.detritusTransferDefinition: Deposited material transfers from plant/material compartments into the detritus pool at its physical destination; it is not a new energy input. Decay removes represented detritus mass and dissipates its energy. No direct detritus export actuator runs.

soil.units: Approximate soil nutrient units: modeled growth consumes .004 units per gram and detritus mineralization returns .004 units per decayed gram. Not elemental mass or a closed nutrient cycle.
soil.nutrientTransferDefinition: No direct soil-to-soil actuator or transfer runs in these trials. Local material deposits return nutrients only through measured mineralization; consumption is plant uptake.
soil.detritusTransferDefinition: Deposited material transfers from plant/material compartments into the detritus pool at its physical destination; it is not a new energy input. Decay removes represented detritus mass and dissipates its energy. No direct detritus export actuator runs.

performance.timingDefinition: Only the authoritative step is timed; diagnostic collection and report creation are included in wallMs, not step samples. Percentiles use nearest rank.

finiteHorizonEvidence.note: Executed primitives and physiological totals are evidence. Technique counters, dialogue, nearby grass and survival on starting reserves are not adequate nutrition or safe relocation.

memory.note: RSS is shared-process RSS including the coordinator and this sequential worker; snapshots may miss peaks. Worker heap is isolate-local. Neither is physical laptop or renderer memory.

limitations: This is regional foundation evidence. Diurnal or short controller trials do not establish multi-day human self-sufficiency, learned relocation, stable predators, seasonal sustainability or indefinite balance.

Ecology runs at its actual native .5-second update, with one .5-second environment tick for each ecology tick. Human trials run the full PopulationRuntime at its normal 1/60-second step. A half-second environment sample is not claimed bit-identical to a 1/60-second live-weather trace.

Excretion, complete elemental nutrient conservation, erosion, runoff, hydrology and a closed nutrient cycle are not implemented. Regional balances only audit the represented soil/detritus pools; any missing flow instrumentation is reported as null.

Initial soil, producer and body stocks are finite initialization, not earned food. Independent human intake is measured through ingestion/absorption totals; initial body reserves and social claims do not count.
Geographic food/water/corridor diagnostics stay outside inhabitants. Structural availability and traversability do not prove an actor can learn, execute or energetically afford acquisition.

No Ollama, renderer, desktop persistence, UI latency, minimized/background behavior, native installation, power mode or physical laptop budget is measured here. Broad laptop readiness needs separate named-hardware measurements.

Population extrema and identity changes are sampled at every .5-second ecology step. Stock/energy trajectories are sampled once per game hour plus endpoints; unobserved within-interval extrema are not claimed.

The four human anchors and both default seeds are development diagnostics, not held-out seeds. No failed start is removed after observing its outcome. Output refuses replacement of an existing historical report.
